Genoa: no Italian exam for English-taught programs

English-taught programs at Genoa need no Italian test. For 2026/27, applicants who need a visa applied from 26 November 2025 to 20 March 2026. 2027/28 dates are not out yet. Last year some programs closed early. Application fee €30.

Source: unige.it (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.

Annual fees at public universities: by income and country

Bologna (minimum): €157.04 (ISEE €27,000 or below, first year, 2026/27)
Sapienza Rome: €300-€1,500 (Türkiye group €700; confirm 2027/28)
Verona: €1,000 (flat option for non-EU without ISEE)
Bozen-Bolzano: about €1,200 (non-EU, two installments)
Turin: €156-€2,800 (one program; 2025-26 range)

The fee depends on ISEE (a family income indicator) or a country list. The upper limit varies by program. Ask the university about extra charges.

Source: unibo.it, uniroma1.it, univr.it, unibz.it, apply.unito.it (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.

Leiden's bachelor's fee doubles depending on the program

2027/28 non-EU bachelor's fee ranges from €14,700 to €31,400: science and biomedical €19,200, Leiden University College €21,120, medicine €31,400. Master's fees and IELTS requirements are set by program.

Source: universiteitleiden.nl (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.
